requirements.statement: The web page shows a text box for entering a name and a 'Say Hello' button

criteria.must: A text box for entering a name is visible on the web page
A 'Say Hello' button is visible on the web page

requirements.statement: Clicking the button sends the entered name to the API

criteria.must: Clicking the 'Say Hello' button triggers a request to the API with the entered name

requirements.statement: The API responds with 'Hello, <name>!' in the response body

criteria.must: The API returns a response containing 'Hello, <name>!' where <name> is the provided name

requirements.statement: The response is in JSON format with a message field

criteria.must: The API response is valid JSON
The API response contains a 'message' field

requirements.statement: The web page displays the greeting returned by the API

criteria.must: The greeting from the API response is displayed on the web page

requirements.statement: When no name is entered, the greeting defaults to 'Welcome, Stranger!'

criteria.must: Clicking the button with an empty text box results in a greeting of 'Welcome, Stranger!'

requirements.statement: The API is accessible via a single endpoint

criteria.must: The API provides a single endpoint for greeting requests
API requests succeed without providing authentication credentials
